definitions.tcp_state: last three observation.state values; measured pinch_pos in meters
definitions.expert_timing: zero-based observation/action frame indices; snapshot precedes that frame action
definitions.policy_geometry: rounded, sparse post-step terminal samples; not a full trace
definitions.later_y: active Y labels after a gap of at least one inactive frame following the first Y burst
definitions.offline_hit: correct Y sign and absolute prediction >=0.05; reset action queue per expert frame

limitations: In-sample first-action predictions do not show the online full chunk.
Missed later Y labels occur on both sides; they alone do not explain the asymmetry.
Scheduled cube coordinates are not per-frame measured cube poses.
This CPU analysis does not run or certify new policy rollouts.
